During the Gun Devil arc, he was killed and possessed by 20% of the Gun Devil, thus becoming the host of the の|Jū no Majin}}.

Aki was a handsome, tall young man with medium-length black hair that he usually wore in a topknot style (shoulder-length with long bangs when untied) and blue eyes. In the past when he and Himeno met through Kishibe and became partners, Aki used to have shorter hair.

He often wore the Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform; a suit and tie. He also donned black earrings and usually carried his sword on his back.

After the Gun Devil took over his body, Aki became the Gun Fiend. During this time, his hair was let down and his eyes and forehead were covered in dark veins. The barrel and slide of an M1911 was seen sticking out of his face in between his eyes with the gun’s hammer sticking out the back of his head, Aki's left forearm was replaced with an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M4_carbine M4].

enrichments.description:
Angel resembles a young, beautiful androgynous male, and is always seen wearing the Public Safety suit. He has shoulder-length hair—depicted as red, the color may either specifically be known as "[https://www.crispedge.com/faq/what-is-the-color-of-giants-club/ giant's club]" in the official colored manga or "[https://www.crispedge.com/faq/what-color-is-japonica/ japonica]" in the anime—with a halo floating above it and white wings on his upper back. After the events of the International Assassins arc, Angel loses both of his arms.

The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils, having virtually no hostility towards humans. He considers himself to be a devil first and an angel second, stating that he believes humans ought to die in pain. However, he is later seen apologizing to and comforting certain humans in their deaths, suggesting some form of affection towards humans, which he suggests is a result of being part-Angel.

He dislikes being ordered around and seems to have an aversion to combat, preferring to move an unconscious enemy outside than carry on fighting. His extreme laziness holds him back from being the strong fighter he actually is and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working. When pressed to fight, he shows some reluctance at having to use his abilities and apologizes to the people whose lifespan he has stolen when he uses their lifespan to create weapons.

As a result of his power, the Angel Devil is socially withdrawn and usually is seen isolated from the rest of his fellow devil hunters, with Aki Hayakawa being the only one who has a sort of connection with him as he is the first known human who has not been afraid of touching him.

Private Devil Hunter (formerly) Wild Fiend Host (formerly)

She attends the Fourth East High School with Denji, with whom she briefly attempted to start a relationship, ending in disaster, though she develops a crush on his alter-ego, Chainsaw Man, instead. After a meeting with the Death Devil, she becomes a famous Devil Hunter as a member of the Chainsaw Man Church.

After the Chainsaw Man Church fails, Asa becomes a fugitive and subsequently a terrorist who breaks into a maximum security Public Safety facility to free Chainsaw Man, who is held captive by the state. Following the events of the Aging Devil arc, she's on the run from Public Safety alongside Denji.

Asa is a high school girl of average height. Though initially a little skinny, she later develops a more feminine build, possibly from puberty or her increase in physical strength from being a Devil Hunter. She has dark blue eyes that are usually pitch dark, though the irises become much brighter in some situations. Her hair is black and is sometimes colored with a brown tint. The hair reaches the middle of her back, and she wears it in two low twin tails, making it appear shorter. In the past, Asa wore her hair at shoulder-length. After the events of the Chainsaw Man Church arc, Asa lost her right arm following her fight with Yoshida, and later her remaining arm during her fight with Pochita. This leads to Yoru sacrificing the Tank and Gun Devils to regain their arms while using them as weapons/gauntlets.

Beam possesses the body of a muscular young man. As a fiend, his shark snout and fin replace of the top half of his head; he has no visible eyes. He has short, spiky black hair and very sharp teeth. He exclusively wears swimming trunks.

Beam is very eccentric, naive and innocent. With the exception of Denji, Beam is often very violent and antisocial, and doesn't interact with others. He often goes along with Denji's plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the Chainsaw Devil. His devotion to Chainsaw Man is such that he always tries to protect Denji personally and will offer his blood to revive him, even if ends up severely hurting or killing him.

He is shown to greatly enjoy fighting, eagerly diving into packs of zombies and eating them, though he was greatly afraid of having to fight against Reze to the point of fleeing, but showed no hesitation in trying to fight back against her when cornered.

Beam is among the fighters from the Special Division 4 that are tasked with invading Akane Sawatari's hideout. He emerges from the wall below ground and dives into the pack of zombies, partially transforming his head into a shark head, and kills several of them with ease. He almost accidentally bites through the Violence Fiend but is punched back by him and reverts to his original self.

enrichments.description:
Tatsuki often drew images at an early age. In Junior High School he thought of a magazine in his head and often cut and serialized new works in it, usually serializing seven works. In his first years of high school, he started to upload manga to the website Shintosha.

After graduating, he made several one shots participating in Manga Awards Contents and had won some of them and got noticed by ONE and Sui Ishida. Later those oneshots were republished on Jump+ or Jump SQ.19 magazine. Fujimoto won Honorable Mentions in the November 2013 Shueisha Crown Newcomers' Awards for his debut one-shot story "Love is Blind". He made his official debut in Jump SQ.19 with "Shikaku" and following year published "Nayuta of the Prophecy" in Jump SQ.

Tatsuki made his first serialization with Fire Punch in 2016, ran for eight volumes, published on Jump+ site. The series was proposed for a Jump SQ magazine, but as it was declined, the editor proposed it for a Jump+ serialization and it was approved. The series ran for 8 volumes and gathered the internet attention due to its shocking developments.

After Fire Punch serialization ended, Tatsuki published a new oneshot in Jump SQ 2018-06 Issue, titled Sisters.

The |Kōan Hen}}, officially referred to as Part 1: Public Safety Arc, is the first part of the Chainsaw Man series. Part 1 was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2018 until 2020. It is followed by the Academy Saga.

It follows Denji as he spends his days working as a Devil Hunter at Public Safety.

Denji is a lonely boy who one day meets a Devil, Pochita. The two end up becoming friends, however Denji is soon killed and to save him, Pochita becomes his new heart, making him a human-devil hybrid and allowing him to become the Chainsaw Man. Soon after that, Denji meets Makima and decides to follow her and join the Public Safety and become a Devil Hunter. At his new job, he makes new friends, like Aki Hayakawa and Power, and together they go on different missions to exterminate devils. Eventually, Aki and Power are killed and Makima is exposed to be the Control Devil, who wants to control the Chainsaw Devil. Denji is then forced to fight and defeat Makima and her new squad of hybrids.

The |Gakkō Hen}} is the second and final part of the Chainsaw Man series. Part 2 was serialized in the Shonen Jump+ platform since July 13, 2022 until March 25, 2026. It is preceded by the Public Safety Saga.

It follows Asa Mitaka, host of the War Devil Yoru, as she attempts to locate Chainsaw Man who is enrolled in the same high school as her.

Sometime after leaving the Public Safety, Denji has now started to go to high school, while he also continues to exterminate devils. He still wishes to get a girlfriend and often tries to "accidentally" expose his identity as Chainsaw Man. Meanwhile, the War Devil returns to the world seeking revenge against the Chainsaw Devil. It possesses a lone high school girl, Asa Mitaka, who goes to the same school as Denji and makes her search for the Chainsaw Man's true identity. As the story progresses, Asa and Denji become close, while different factions try to utilize the Chainsaw Devil's power to prevent the coming Prophecy of Nostradamus.

They tend to use contracts with Devils as a means of standing a chance in combat against their monstrous opponents, giving them a massive advantage over standard law enforcement whenever Devils appear.

Due to Denji's role as a Devil Hunter in both the Private Sector and Public Safety, they play a pivotal role in the story of Chainsaw Man.

Counting the Private Sector Devil Hunters, there are over a thousand Devil Hunters in Tokyo, meaning that being a Devil Hunter is considered a common profession. Devil Hunters that work for the government receive a salary regularly, just like any other government employee, while Private Sector Devil Hunters turn in bounties and do not have a permanent regular salary. Other Devil Hunters may choose to sell Devil corpses in the black market as an alternate way to make more money.

Devil Hunters will also sometimes capture Devils instead of killing them, usually for the purpose of using them to form contracts. The Future Devil is a good example of this. Devil Hunters are also the only people who are allowed by government to form a contract with a Devil.

enrichments.description:
A |Majin|lit. "Demonic Person"}} is a Devil that has taken over a corpse.

Fiends are Devils that have taken over human and animal corpses as their last resort to survive. Devils lose a significant amount of their supernatural power after becoming a Fiend. Fiends can be identified by their distinct head shapes, such as Power's horns, Beam's shark head or Pingtsi's hair. Similar to how a Devil's appearance and set of powers may not always represent or fit the theme of their “name” (concept) the same can apply for Fiends.

Fiends will usually retain their original personalities they had as Devils. However, some Fiends retain more of the original corpse's brain than others, leading to their personalities becoming mingled such as Violence Fiend, who should be inclined towards violence, but instead prefers peace. It should be noted that this type of Fiend is extremely rare, being the exception not the rule, as well as how a "mingled" Fiend is still just a Devil whose own personality happened to absorb the traits and/or memories of the human or animal as they remain dead.

There is also a “type” of condition in the series with the protagonist characters of Part 2 that hasn’t been named yet so it is unconfirmed if it is truly a Fiend or not, but for the sake of simplicity and until anything actually gets confirmed the condition will be referred to as a "Fiend and Fiend Host." Devils may also deliberately choose to retain half of the original corpse's brain to blend into society, causing a living Fiend host, as with Asa Mitaka's possession by the War Devil. With Fiends of the living host variety, both personalities exist separately in one body until the Devil decides to take over the remaining brain or relinquishes full control back to the human.

Hell is a surreal, dreamlike location that operates on rules completely different from Earth. Its landscape varies widely. One section features grassy plains and flowery hills beneath countless doors floating parallel in the sky. Other areas are featureless voids of black or white with occasional doors, while another holds a vast, dark ocean centered around a single platform covered in doorways.

Not much is known about Hell, except that Devils are born there, and return to it when they die on Earth. Devils which are killed in Hell are reincarnated on Earth. It is later revealed by Makima that once, the Chainsaw Devil was a resident of Hell, and he is known as the "Hero of Hell" for killing Devils.

Santa Claus sacrifices the life of one of her perfect dolls to the Hell Devil along with three of her adopted children to forcibly take everybody inside a department store to Hell, where they are all attacked by the Darkness Devil.

Later, Makima forced Tolka, one of Santa Claus' perfect dolls, to make a contract with Hell Devil to take everybody back to Earth.

enrichments.description:
After disappearing from his battle with the Four Horsemen and Weapon Devils, Pochita is reduced to a “near-death state”. In this state, he appears to be a small orange canine-like Devil with a chainsaw-like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw, and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord.

Pochita's true Devil form is of a large, muscular humanoid Devil with two forearms split at the elbow of each hand and a chainsaw protruding from each, with another chainsaw coming from the front of his head, similar to Denji's Hybrid form. Unlike Denji, he has horns on his head and does not appear to have visible eyes in his true form, though this doesn't seem to affect his sight. He towers over regular-sized humans and possesses dark armored plates or scales that cover his entire body. An intestine still connected to his stomach is wrapped around his neck, resembling a scarf or a collar. It can be used to carry people like Kobeni Higashiyama or impale opponents with brute force.

After making a contract with Denji, Pochita assimilates himself with him, fusing with his heart and becoming part of Denji's anatomy, thus creating a hybrid. This allows Denji to become Chainsaw Man by pulling the chainsaw cord in his chest.

In this state, Pochita is smaller, has lost the chainsaw on his head, all his appendages and both handles. Pochita also has blood vessels connected to Denji. Pochita however still retains his trademark cute canine face. Denji's chainsaw cord is also directly connected to the top of Pochita's head.

enrichments.description:
Power possesses the corpse of an unknown woman or girl with long hair. She mainly appears being blonde. Her hair color varies from blonde to pink in manga illustrations, even appearing dirty blonde in some official art, and appears strawberry blonde in the anime. As a Fiend, she has red and yellow eyes that form a cross pattern, sharp teeth with defined fangs, and light red horns protruding from the top of her head. If Power accumulates too much blood, her horns become larger and more curved, and she can sprout additional pairs of horns from the sides of her head.

Power usually wears the standard dress shirt, tie, and slacks required of Public Safety Devil Hunters. Normally, she wears breast pads to increase the size of her bust. She almost always wears her jacket hanging halfway off her body giving her an untidy, half-dressed appearance. In a new reality where Pochita never existed, Power wears her hair in pigtails while donning her jacket over her Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform as a Devil Hunter working under Nayuta's command.

In her の|Chi no Akuma}} form, she appears as a tall humanoid with four arms and a mostly pale-skinned body. Her head has a pointed appearance with a red color, sharp teeth, and two circular eyes with cross-like pupils. She also has long horns, resembling how her Fiend form looked with too much blood, and longer hair in this form. Her chest has an open rib cage showing a chest cavity full of intestines up to her neck. Her arms have red coloration from hand to elbow. She has four-fingered hands and large claws. Her legs have the same red coloration from the mid-thigh down, ending in heel-like feet and she has a cat-like tail.

Power is childish, greedy, and almost entirely self-motivated. She tends to fight as if she has something to gain and is certain of her victory, and has no problems with running away from a fight where she is outmatched. She feels the need to boast her superiority over her fellow Devil Hunters due to her status as a Fiend. She has no loyalty to humans or Devils, openly admitting that she will join whichever is the winning side. Power also enjoys the thrill of a fight and enjoys showing off her strength and proving her own superiority. When she was in front of an swarm of zombies, she got excited and told Denji to watch carefully how she single-handedly defeats all of them. She is highly egotistical and often claims she is capable of doing things she cannot actually do, only to abandon them halfway through when the situation turns sour for her. She frequently deflects the consequences of her actions to those around her.

She is later revealed to be the の|Shihai no Akuma}} who embodies the concept of control or conquest and a member of the Four Horsemen at the time. Following her death, she was reincarnated as Nayuta.

Makima is a Devil resembling a human woman in her twenties, of very slight build, and marginally above average height. She has long light red/pale auburn hair, normally kept in a loose braid with bangs reaching just past her eyebrows and two longer side bangs that frame her face. Her eyes are yellow with multiple red rings within them, making them the only visible sign of her inhuman nature.

Her usual Public Safety uniform consists of a white long-sleeved shirt, a black tie, black pants and brown shoes. During early arcs, she would also wear a long black trenchcoat over her uniform, showing mostly the tie and nothing else. She usually wears a calm expression on her face, and she is seen smiling most of the time throughout the anime.

On the surface, Makima seems to be a kind, gentle, social and friendly woman who is usually seen wearing a smile on her face the entire time and acts relaxed and confident even during a crisis, speaking in a professional tone to her workers. As her natural appearance is nearly identical to that of a human, she avoids disclosing her Devil nature to most of her underlings and spends much of the series posing as a human contracted to a Devil rather than a Devil herself. However, this is only a façade that she uses to fulfil her ultimate goal. After the death of Aki Hayakawa, Makima begins to reveal her true colors to Denji. Makima's true face is of someone that is Machiavellian and calculating, who sees people around her as nothing more than "dogs" she can use as much as she likes and must obey her without any hesitation for her goals.

enrichments.description:
Kishibe is a tall, grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. In his young adult years, his hair was black, but it has turned grey in the manga. In the anime, he has more a blonde hair color, possibly indicating it's dyed. Additionally, Kishibe has two piercings on his left ear and one on his right ear. He typically wears the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform, complimented by a large overcoat.

He is often seen with a silver hip flask which he frequently drinks from.

Kishibe is a jaded, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Kishibe seems to have a somewhat strange sense of humor, saying horrifying things with a completely straight face, making it hard to tell if he's actually joking or not. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral.

Despite this stoicism, Kishibe has proven on numerous occasions to be something of a sentimental and emotional individual. During his training of Denji and Power, despite his stated hatred of Fiends and Devils, he grows affectionate towards the pair, telling Makima of his concerns for their safety. He later takes care of Meowy for them as a favor when they go on a trip. Similarly, he refuses to look at the corpse of Quanxi upon her death due to their implied past-friendship, despite the two's attempts to kill one another earlier in the day.

She serves as the titular main antagonist of the Bomb Girl arc and a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc.

Reze appears to be a young woman or girl, and is of slender build. She has shoulder-length purple hair and emerald-green eyes. She is shown to be prone to blushing heavily. While posing as a civilian, she is seen wearing a choker in order to conceal the grenade pin in her neck, which she uses to transform.

In her debut appearance, she wore a loose shirt with stylized drawing of a bell on the front, and a backpack. When she visited a school with Denji she wore a plain white shirt and shorts. While working at the café Crossroads she wears an apron.

Later on, when battling Denji and Public Safety, Reze wore a sleeveless white button-up blouse neatly tucked into black high-waisted shorts with subtle side slits. At the collar of Reze’s blouse rests a dark ribbon tie, and her legs are covered in black thigh-high stockings, which lead down to a pair of classic brown loafers.

In the Public Safety Saga, she serves as the secondary antagonist in the International Assassins arc and as a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc. Quanxi later returns in the Academy Saga as a supporting character, having rejoined Public Safety once more as a member of Special Division 7.

Quanxi is a tall woman with cream colored hair tied back into a ponytail. She wears an eye patch over her right eye, has a brown left eye, and possesses an athletic build with rather wide hips. In her debut arc, she wears a black tank top tucked into waist-high pants with a large belt during her mission to retrieve Denji's heart. When in combat, Quanxi dons a set of sheathes on her back, holding up to three swords which resemble Dao.

In Part 2, Quanxi currently wears the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie, which she wore during her past stint in Public Safety and also during her time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants. Her eyepatch sports a different design, now appearing to be made of frilled lace instead of leather. She also wears a matching, black lace choker.

In her transformed state, Quanxi's teeth sharpen along her head, transforming into hardened arrows with wide curved horns taking the shape of a bow on the side of her head. Arrowheads stick out of her neck while her forearms grow glove-like flesh with sharpened bow-shaped attachments.

enrichments.description:
Chainsaw Man (Japanese: チェンソーマン, Hepburn: Chensō Man) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Tatsuki Fujimoto. Its first arc was serialized in Shueisha's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump from December 2018 to December 2020; its second arc was serialized in Shueisha's Shōnen Jump+ app and website from July 2022 to March 2026. Its chapters were collected in 24 tankōbon volumes.

Chainsaw Man follows the story of Denji, an impoverished teenager who makes a contract that fuses his body with that of Pochita, a dog-like Chainsaw Devil, granting him the ability to transform parts of his body into chainsaws. Denji eventually joins the Public Safety Devil Hunters, a government agency focused on combating Devils whenever they become a threat to Japan. The second arc of the story focuses on Asa Mitaka, a high school student who enters into a contract with Yoru, the War Devil, who forces her to hunt down Chainsaw Man and seek revenge against him for her near-destruction.

In North America, the manga is licensed in English by Viz Media, for both print and digital release, and it is also published by Shueisha on the Manga Plus online platform. An anime television series adaptation, produced by MAPPA, was broadcast from October to December 2022. An anime film, titled Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc, premiered in September 2025. An anime adaptation of the "Assassins" arc has been announced.

By June 2026, the manga had over 36 million copies in circulation. In 2021, it won the 66th Shogakukan Manga Award in the shōnen category and won the Harvey Award in the Best Manga category from 2021 to 2023. Chainsaw Man has been overall well-received by critics, who have praised its storytelling, characters, and dark humor, with its violent scenes being particularly highlighted within the context of the story.

A seraph (Hebrew: שָׂרָף, romanized: sārāf ; plural seraphim Hebrew: שְׂרָפִים, romanized: sərāfīm ) is a celestial or heavenly being originating in Ancient Judaism. The term plays a role in subsequent Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

Tradition places seraphim in the highest rank in Christian angelology and in the fifth rank of ten in the Jewish angelic hierarchy. A seminal passage in the Book of Isaiah (Isaiah 6:1–8) used the term to describe six-winged beings that fly around the Throne of God crying out "holy, holy, holy". This throne scene, with its triple invocation of holiness, profoundly influenced subsequent theology, literature, and art. Its influence is frequently seen in works depicting angels, heaven, and apotheosis. Seraphim are mentioned as celestial beings in the semicanonical Book of Enoch and the canonical Book of Revelation.

enrichments.description:
A virtue (Latin: virtus) is a trait of excellence, including traits that may be moral, social, or intellectual. The cultivation and refinement of virtue is held to be the "good of humanity" and thus is valued as an end purpose of life or a foundational principle of being. In human practical ethics, a virtue is a disposition to choose actions that succeed in showing high moral standards: doing what is said to be right and avoiding what is wrong in a given field of endeavour, even when doing so may be unnecessary from a utilitarian perspective. When someone takes pleasure in doing what is right, even when it is difficult or initially unpleasant, they can establish virtue as a habit. Such a person is said to be virtuous through having cultivated such a disposition. The opposite of virtue is vice.

Other examples of this notion include the concept of merit in Asian traditions as well as De (Chinese 德, "character," "integrity").

The Accident Devil appears as an amalgamation of twisted cars, jagged metal fragments, and mechanical wreckage, forming a chaotic and industrial mass. Notably, a grotesque humanoid face with long hair is embedded near the lower portion of its form, evoking the imagery of victims trapped within wreckage.

entities.description:
The いの|Oi no Akuma}} is a Devil bearing the name of a primal fear, namely embodying the concept of aging, and the titular main antagonist of the Aging Devil arc.

The Aging Devil is a tall devil with a thin and gaunt physique, resembling a withered aggregate of flesh with several holes in it. The largest hole is placed right in the center of its chest, where the heart should be. Its face, which emerges from the split head of an old person with long hair, is a smooth surface with only a mouth, connected by several strings to the two halves of the previous face. The Aging Devil's feet have raised heels, similar to stiletto shoes.

It sits on a throne made of flesh and bones, with human fingers decorating the back and tongues, mouths and teeth protruding from the base which is supported by the backs of two naked men with their hands cut off.

The Aging Devil is shown to be apathetic to any forms of life, both its own and that of others, as described by Fumiko, but seems to detest youth, most likely because they do not fear them. However, it is shown to possess an amicable relationship with Public Safety, evident by it complimenting Yoshida for subduing Pochita.

entities.name: Aging Devil's Victim
entities.description:
Aging Devil's Victim (real name unknown) is a former Devil Hunter who was trapped in Aging's World. He serves as a supporting character in the latter half of the Aging Devil Arc.

The Aging Devil Victim is a young-to-middle-aged Japanese man with short black hair and short but thick sideburns. His eyebrows are equally thick and his eyes naturally droop downward. He also sports a large mole on his left cheek, in addition to noticeable eyebags, as well as laugh lines that are only visible upon close inspection. During his stay in the Aging Devil’s realm he donned a traditional fundoshi, but adapted to modern clothing after he left.

Prior to entering the Aging Devil's world, he's described as being the perfect Devil Hunter; proud, proficient at his job, sociable and well-respected among his peers. However, he held a deep insecurity about his physical appearance, as he was willing to make a contract with a theoretical Aging Devil just to reverse his signs of aging. Initially, he was fine with this, as he believed that the Aging Devil chose him and a few others for a special purpose. As the years went by, however, his faith in the Aging Devil dwindled, with the final straw being the introduction of Denji into their realm.

After being trapped in the Aging Devil's realm for 82 years, with no one else around his age to accompany him, he slowly began to lose his mind. When Asa was the first person to join him in years, he wrote her off as a hallucination of a former friend that was there to keep him company. He tends to have episodes of mania or insanity where he grips onto any nearby tree and wails, which Yoru reckons is his way of escaping the reality of his current situation. He's also gone out of his way to attempt suicide on multiple occasions as a means of escape, though these attempts proved fruitless.

entities.name: Aldo
entities.description:
Aldo is a man of average height with short black hair and light colored eyes. He also has two vertical scars crossing his right eye.

Unlike his brothers, Aldo is actually a very sensitive person. He's easily scared by the deaths of other people, his common reaction being to puke when he sees a corpse. He also empathizes with the person he was acting as, to the point of crying once he learned about his life.

He tends to be very insecure and constantly reassures himself that he's immortal and that he can do the thing he sets his mind to. This reaches the point that, for most of the arc, everyone believes he's just a civvie instead of an important hitman.

Aldo is also very determined and intelligent. Some fans believe he wasn't actually an infected doll, but rather he was acting as such to escape. He tends to think before acting, at least when he tried to attack Denji. He motivates himself by the words of his brothers, who he admires deeply.

entities.description:
Asa's caretaker works at the orphanage that Asa and other children were sent to after their parents died because of Devils. She herself claimed that she lost her mother because of the Typhoon Devil, just like Asa, though whether or not this was an attempt to manipulate Asa is unclear.

She noticed that Asa was using her cat, Crambon, for companionship instead of befriending the other orphans and told her she had a friend who owned numerous cats. Convinced that her cat would be happier at such a place, Asa entrusted him to the caretaker. As it turned out, she was envious that Asa still had somewhat of a family while she and the other orphans didn't, so she drowned Crambon in the nearby river.

She is a woman of average height and build, with dark eyes and black hair that she keeps tied in a bun. She wears a bright-colored shirt, black pants and an apron.

On the surface, the caretaker seems kind and empathetic, seemingly wanting the best for everyone. However, in truth, she is a manipulative, jealous, and bitter sociopath who intentionally lured an orphaned girl into a false sense of security only to take away her one remaining source of happiness.

Although his face is not shown, Asa's father has short black hair much like his daughter and wore a light-colored shirt and dark-colored pants.

According to Asa, he was an unemployed man who was always alcoholic and sometimes violent. This extended to him being unfaithful towards his own wife and having cheated on her. Despite these negative traits, he chose to protect his daughter from a hostile Devil before his demise at the hands of his own wife.

In the dreamscape, Asa recounts to Denji that her family was attacked by a devil, which ripped off her father's leg. Her mother fought the devil off with a stone and applied pressure to the wound while instructing Asa to call for devil hunters. When the hunters arrived, they found Asa's father deceased with the bloodied stone beside him.

entities.name: Asa Mitaka's Mother
entities.description:
Asa Mitaka's Mother is the unnamed mother of Asa Mitaka. She was killed by the Typhoon Devil several years prior to the Academy Saga.

She bore heavy resemblance to her daughter, and was slightly taller and has a more developed physique than her at the time of her passing. Her resemblance to her daughter is even stronger in later chapters as she shares her daughter’s eyes. Her hair was neatly tied into a knot at the top of her head.

She seemed to be a kind and warmhearted mother to Asa, accepting her daughter's flaws but comforting her when was feeling down. She was also altruistic, pushing Asa out of harm's way at the cost of her own life. Her love is reciprocated by Asa, who deeply treasures the uniform she wears as a keepsake. She also had a fierce side and would do anything for the sake of her daughter, dirtying her own hands, and killing her husband to earn insurance money so that Asa could attend high school. However, she also has a hidden vindictive and hateful side, as it is heavily implied that part of the desire to kill her husband was because he had cheated on her and wasn't doing any work or providing income for their family.

Several years before the main story, Mitaka's home that she shared with her daughter and seemingly her husband was destroyed by a rampaging Typhoon Devil. After Asa tripped and fell trying to rescue a cat, she shoved Asa out of harm's way, and took the brunt of destruction at the cost of her own life.

entities.description:
Barem Bridge (バルエム・ブリッチ, Baruemu Buritchi) is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the の|Kaen Hōsha-ki no Akuma}} and serves as a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc, where he faces the Chainsaw Devil.

He later returns in the Academy Saga as a major antagonist, serving as the main antagonist of the Chainsaw Man Church arc and a supporting antagonist in the Aging Devil arc. As the second-in-command of the Chainsaw Man Church, Barem aims to continue Makima's legacy by ruining Denji's life while working with Fami to prevent the Death Devil from destroying all of mankind.

Barem is a tall man with relatively long black hair that’s swept behind his ears, with the exception of one strand of hair that drops from his forehead and connects to his right eyebrow. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, he wore a standard Devil Hunter uniform consisting of a suit and tie.

After joining the Chainsaw Man Church, he ties his hair into a ponytail and wears a white buttoned shirt with white pants and black suspenders. He keeps his black necktie, now tucked in the shirt's breast pocket.

entities.name: Bat Devil
entities.description:
The |Kōmori no Akuma}} is a Devil who embodies the concept of bats. He is the primary antagonist of the titular Bat Devil arc and a minor antagonist in the Justice Devil arc.

The Bat Devil resembles an enormous humanoid bat with a grotesque face featuring multiple sharp teeth and large round eyes with a muscular body. His arms are connected to his torso by flaps of skin which also serve as wings. During his introduction he was missing his right arm, but regrew it after drinking Denji's blood. While keeping Meowy prisoner, he wore a birdcage on a chain around his neck which he kept the cat in. Throughout his fight with Denji, he loses the same arm once again. His body has dark-purple coloration, though in the anime it is changed to a simplistic dark-grey.

After his death, the Bat Devil returned to Earth with a different, more rabid and furry appearance. His eyes are now constantly bulged, with his snout more-apparently fleshy which leads into his always-agape mouth, full of jagged teeth. His muscle mass from his prior form has disappeared as well, instead looking fluffier and less defined. The fur of his arms ends at his elbows, instead leading into fleshy human-like forearms and hands with wing-like growths hanging off of them. His feet have also developed into eagle-like talons.

The Bat Devil, like most devils, has a great hatred towards humans, mostly because of them cutting off his arm and forcing him to go into hiding. He has a refined sense of taste, considering Denji and Power to be disgusting and treating humanity as a variety of different meals for him to consume and enjoy. He is particularly fond of eating children, as well as general humans with perfectly healthy bodies. The Bat Devil is seemingly capable of affection with other devils, having a relationship with the Leech Devil who mourned his death.

The Bitterness Devil has a large head with small horns, goat-like eyes, and a mouth with few teeth. It also has sparse hair on the top and sides of its head, as well as a scruffy stubble.

The Bitterness Devil's personality is currently unknown.

At some point after breaking free from Public Safety's trap, Pochita proceeds to erase more Devils by consuming them as he continues to rampage through the city, including the Bitterness Devil. Upon remembering Aki and Power while vomiting out the Snow Devil in the Aging's World, Denji pukes out the Bitterness Devil, restoring the concept of bitterness back to existence. Originally, she appeared to be mild-mannered and supportive, such as when she sought out and consoled Asa Mitaka after their class was given Bucky. In reality, she was delusional, presumptuous and narcissistic, believing that Asa was having a sexual relationship with their teacher, Mr. Tanaka, whom she herself had been having a sexual relationship with.

entities.name: Cosmo
entities.description:
Cosmo possesses a corpse with spiky pink shoulder-length hair fashioned into pigtails with red hairbands. She also has hearts for pupils, colored either orange-red or yellow-red, and her right eye usually hangs out of its socket. It is inconsistent how much her right eye sticks out but it is probably retractable, as in one instance it seems as if she can move the eye on its own. The upper right side of her head is gone, exposing her brain, part of which trails down past her face. The trailing part of her brain is tied into a bow at the end. She wears a long sleeved cropped orange sweater, light blue high-waisted shorts, and pink sneakers.

On the surface, Cosmo doesn't exhibit many emotions aside from her usual smiling, happy-go-lucky attitude. She doesn't speak except for repeating the word "Halloween" and, like the rest of Quanxi's fiends, follows Quanxi around and is in constant love with her and under her command.

When Cosmo uses her powers on Santa Claus, the two had a conversation in Cosmo's mind, revealing her true, inner personality. Here, she is capable of talking normally, conversing with Santa Claus about what's happening. She is straightforward and formal in her manner of speaking, seeming far less excitable than her outward personality. Cosmo was not particularly upset about her girlfriends' murders, explaining that she has no emotions strong enough to drive her to be upset about "the course of nature". Her true personality therefore seems more logical, detached from others, and mostly devoid of emotion.

Her surface personality might be the result of her powers affecting her, causing her to only say "Halloween." However, unlike those she inflicts her power upon, Cosmo is still capable of understanding the speech of others and seems to be capable of thinking, as she is able to take orders and carry them out just fine.

After the attack, having no family left, Asa adopted the cat and named it Crambon. Together with Asa, he was moved to an orphanage for children whose families have been killed by Devils.

There, her caretaker, whose mother also (allegedly) died because of the Typhoon Devil, convinced her to give Crambon away to give him a happier home. However, another orphan later told Asa that the children found Crambon drowned in a river. It turned out that the caretaker had lied to Asa and killed Crambon because she was jealous that Asa still had someone she considered family.

The Darkness Devil's body is made up of many emaciated human bodies, with two bodies acting as its legs and four other human bodies acting as its torso, each having a unique face: the one immediately below the neck has no eyes, nose and a vertical mouth, the second head has open eyes and a stitched mouth, the third one has no nose, an open mouth and stitched eyes, and the fourth one has no eyes and a somber expression. Its head is akin to that of a pteranodon with curved horns. The first human body has its arms stretching outwards holding what seems to be a cape of darkness.

Nothing is currently known about the Darkness Devil's personality, except that it will attack anything it perceives as a threat. Even though it is almost entirely silent, it is shown to be intelligent and capable of reasoning, as a human can make a contract with it. She is the eldest of the Four Horsemen, first mentioned by her younger sister Makima and eventually appearing under the alias of the Famine Devil, Fami. Soon after revealing herself to have been Death all along, "Fami" forgoes her false persona and adopts the name instead.

As the の|Saiaku no Kyōfu|lit. "Worst Fear"}} and the の|Kyōfu no Daimaō|lit. "Great Devil King of Fear"}}, the Death Devil is prophesied to descend on Earth in July of 1999 and bring upon the apocalypse, which would end humanity and usher in an の|Akuma no Jidai}}.

Posing as a student at Fourth East High School and being the true leader of the Chainsaw Man Church, her actions are what drives the story's events as well as the conflict between mankind and Devils, but it's later revealed that she managed to subvert the Prophecy into a more catastrophic future.

In the past, the Fake Chainsaw Man was once a heroic individual who strived to do the right thing as he admired Chainsaw Man's heroism and saved the Fire Devil with his younger brother. However, after witnessing Denji allowing his younger brother to die at the hands of a Devil to save a cat, the person became vengeful towards him for not saving his brother. She is the titular main antagonist of the Falling Devil arc, though she is just a subordinate to the Death Devil, and is a major antagonist in the Academy Saga.

Upon arriving on Earth, she assembled herself a form out of mangled human corpses, and takes the form of a large, big-breasted, feminine, well endowed headless humanoid creature composed of corpses with hands for feet and a pointed tendril covering her groin. This also appears to be her true form, as demonstrated by the miniature version of herself she becomes when not active.

In addition to two multi-jointed arms, she has a pair of scythe-like limbs resembling featherless wings and two more pairs of arms sprouting from her back. One pair holds a decapitated head with a black ponytail; blood endlessly drips out of the ever-closed eyes, nostrils and mouth.

Her most notable trait is her chef uniform, which consists of a tall toque, black leggings, long, black gloves, a white chef jacket, and a black waist apron.

entities.name: Fami
entities.description:
Fami poses as a student at Fourth East High School and is the true leader of the Chainsaw Man Church. Her goal is to stop the Prophecy of Nostradamus, which would bring about the Age of Devils and the end of humanity.

Fami takes on the appearance of a young woman who wears a high school uniform and a black cap from the Devil Hunter Club. She has grayish mountbatten pink colored neck-length hair and has several moles on her face. Similar to the other Horsemen, she has piercing, multiple-ringed eyes. On a colored manga cover her eyes are shown to be pink. Her ears feature four green earrings, two of which are beads on her right and the other two are unusually long and have a triangular shape at the end.

Fami has a very mysterious personality and shows little outward emotion. She is always calm, cold, and composed and also seems to be very good at reading others, as she accurately describes both Asa's and Denji's characters. Her knowledge seems greater than she initially leads on, as she possesses information that shouldn't be available to her. Fami doesn't care if someone discovers her true identity and therefore puts little to no effort into her alias. What's more is that she doesn't necessarily seem to be as outwardly malicious as her brethren, even informing Public Safety officials such as Yoshida about more dangerous Devils, albeit after being threatened first. Despite being intelligent, she can underestimate others, believing that Asa, like most people, would be willing to do anything to survive if forced to, which gets proven wrong.

Fami is more than willing to sacrifice people for her goals. For example, she traps Asa and her fellow club members in an aquarium, knowing that they will starve and suffer, and tries to turn Yoru into a pawn of hers so she can use her as a weapon against the apocalypse. To achieve the latter, she unleashes the Falling Devil on Earth, which not only causes high casualties and worldwide destruction but also ends up not working, making the deaths meaningless. Later, Fami also condemns hundreds of thousands of civilians to lose their minds under the influence of the Fire Devil so that her plans come to fruition. She prefers lethal methods in combat, ordering the Guillotine Devil to hack her enemies to pieces and being disappointed when it only disarms them. However, she spares the likes of Haruka Iseumi after he denounces his loyalty to her, presumably because she doesn't find him worthy of her attention.

entities.name: Famine Devil
entities.description:
After failing to stop her eldest sister from enacting her plans, Fami is brainwashed into serving her and is commanded to plunge humanity into an abyss of terror alongside the Fake Chainsaw Man.

Fami takes on the appearance of a young woman with long unkempt blonde hair that falls in uneven layers and strands. Some of her strands stick out, with bangs across her forehead and sides that reach her ears, and a pair of longer bangs that loosely reach her collarbones. Like the rest of her sisters, the Famine Devil possesses green multiple-ringed eyes and wears the standard Fourth East High School uniform, similar to other Horsemen Devils attending the high school. In most of her appearances, she wears a nervous expression on her face and is usually shown crying.

Fami has a meek and taciturn demeanor and is very outwardly emotional, in stark contrast with her sisters. She was nervous when introducing herself to students of Fourth East High School, crying throughout her entire introduction and openly bawling when she saw that nobody was paying attention to her. At the same time, she appears to have somewhat of a high opinion of herself, refusing to take out the trash because it would be a waste of her superior talents. Despite this, when she's chastised by a student for her behavior and told to go "crush ants", she actually goes outside to do so. When she's easily dispatched by the Fake Chainsaw Man, she immediately resorts to begging for her life by offering him a meager ¥2,000 from her wallet, demonstrating an overt cowardice that her sisters lack.

Fami appears to pity humanity and arrives claiming to save them with her special powers. Her notion of salvation seems to be releasing humans from their suffering through death, as she believes her means of doing so will ease any pain that War or Death could cause. Although she does not display the same bravado as Devils like Makima and Yoru and can be argued to be benevolent, Fami is still deeply fatalistic, as seen in her way of "saving" humanity: in order to mend her injuries, she spares no thought to an innocent student who wanted to help her and immediately steals his life force. Despite this, her pleading for Death to kill herself does display that she, in her own warped sense, ultimately sides with humanity over Devils.

It also serves as the titular overarching antagonist of the Justice Devil arc under the guise of the Justice Devil. Those who form contracts with the Fire Devil gain immense power but are slowly driven to insanity by a twisted desire for self-righteous "justice".

For unknown reasons before the twin brothers found the Fire Devil, it had sustained unexplained injuries, which the siblings proceeded to treat. In this form, the Fire Devil appeared significantly diminished in size, with only the flame atop its head remaining visible.

The Fire Devil's true appearance is a tall devil with a flaming head. Its neck is surrounded in sticks resembling a campfire or a wooden pyre. Its upper body is adorned with a jagged mantle of burning branches, charred wood, or skeletal twigs, resembling a crown of scorched remains from neck to surrounding shoulders. The arms appear stretched and unnaturally shaped in a way that resembles ashen logs and its hands and fingers of dry wood. It wears a seemingly burnt robe. Thin, flame-like or branch-like extensions emerge from its back, enhancing its demonic silhouette.

Its face is surprisingly humanoid with the top half obscured by flame. It has two right eyes that pokes through the fire and none on the left side of its face, and its mouth resembles an arrow pointing up or a cross.

entities.name: Fumiko Mifune
entities.description:
She later serves as a major antagonist in the Aging Devil arc, where she initiated Public Safety's plan to sacrifice the lives of 10,000 children to allow the Aging Devil to get consumed by the Chainsaw Devil, and as a minor antagonist in the War Devil arc.

Fumiko Mifune is a jolly young woman with short black hair. Her hair has a rather unkempt appearance though her bangs are tied into two ponytails at each side of her face. Fumiko's eyes are unusually large with giant black irises, containing a red circle within them. Her unusual eyes could be explained by her Devil contract, as was the case with Akane Sawatari. Her demeanor is also quite unique, as she is usually seen wearing a wide, uncanny smile on her face.

On the surface, Fumiko generally seems like a very upbeat woman who constantly has a smile on her face. However, this is only a façade that she uses, as Fumiko is revealed to be a psychopath, and she is fully prepared to initiate Public Safety's plan to sacrifice the lives of 10,000 children with Japanese citizenship, claiming she wants to ensure humanity's evolution by forming a contract with the Aging Devil. This is shown to be a deception; her duplicitous nature is evidenced by a lack of sympathy for others and allegiance only to her own self-preservation, as she has turned various humans all over the world into duplicates of herself via sexual intercourse.

All of Fumiko's clones have developed their own personalities. Each of them are stationed around the world and met up at a secret location in a villa at unknown points of the year to exchange information and just catch up on their shared experiences, with one commenting that she is surprised that most of the clones developed their own fears and were contrastingly different from one another.

In the anime, the mask has more muted colors, such as grey and beige, and some yellow.

When he doesn't have his plague doctor mask on, he becomes much taller, very muscular, has spiky black hair, and has 4 empty eyes.

Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, Galgali is extremely polite and straightforward. This is first shown when he apologized to Beam after hitting him in self-defense, and telling Princi to evacuate the area when he mistook her for a human lady.

Galgali attributes this to him still possessing a lot of his human's brain which is unusual for a fiend. He somewhat ironically states that he loves peace and love, and remembers a lot of the details of "his former life as a human."

The Ghost Devil is a large devil with a somewhat cylindrical body; its torso is covered in white flowers with either yellow or pink centers and has several arms instead of legs. In the colored manga it seems to have skin (arms and legs) of a grey hue but change in tint depending on the scene. Its head appears old and desiccated, with long dark wavy or curly hair and sunken cheeks. The Ghost Devil's eyes and mouth are sewn shut. In the anime, the flowers are pink on the outside and blue on the inside.

The Ghost Devil's personality is largely unknown except that it initially refused to fight against Katana Man because it was scared of Akane Sawatari, but after Himeno offered up her entire body as payment to the Ghost Devil, it quickly changed its mind and showed excitement. During Aki Hayakawa's final confrontation with the Ghost Devil, it is shown to harbor residual sentiment for its previous contract, Himeno, as it carried Aki's first cigarettes with it for years until Aki was ready.

At some point, the Ghost Devil formed a contract with Himeno allowing her to control its right hand in exchange for consuming her right eye.

The Guillotine Devil is reminiscent of a large, monstrous pigeon. It features a pair of ears at the base of its beak, and its head maintains a constant right-leaning tilt.

In spite of being Death's pawn, the Guillotine Devil shows an unusual level of independence as it only cuts apart the weapons and clothes of Public Safety members instead of killing them as Death orders it. It is unknown whether this was out of mercy or defiance against her enslaver. When faced with a considerable threat, it retreats and leaves its master to fend for herself. Its intelligence seems to be on the lower spectrum as it can only repeat the phrase "Gyohnee!!" but is intelligent enough to follow its orders to a limited extent.

entities.description:
Haruka is a slim young man who wears a bandana, an all-black uniform, and a military cap with a symbol. He has black hair combed to the side of his face. He has a pull cord in his chest identical to that of Pochita's in Denji's chest, later revealed to be a surgical implant.

Haruka seems to be benevolent and prideful on a surface level; he has a habit of constantly introducing himself in an extravagant manner and he holds his position as president of both the student council and the Devil Hunter Club in high regard. As of such, he tends to lead those around him, instructing others on how to handle a situation, utilizing their skillset to their advantage.

However, he can also be very demeaning to those he views as having no worth to the club, such as when he berates Asa for accidentally destroying her phone when she tried to help out. It's also shown that he can be fairly manipulative, lying to others that he is indeed the real Chainsaw Man, likely in order to boost his own popularity. However, when cornered in the aquarium he easily admits that his ripcord is simply a surgical implant and reveals himself to simply be a massive fan of the Chainsaw Man. Haruka doesn't seem exceptionally brave. When cornered in the aquarium he breaks down screaming for Chainsaw Man to save him, he is later also shown to be easily intimidated by others.

His devotion to Chainsaw Man is shown to be the main cause as to why he co-lead the Chainsaw Man Church as its "face," as he didn't have the same ulterior motives held by Barem and "Fami". In fact, their plan involving the Fire Devil is shown to take a mental toll on him, and he swears to never get involved with Fami or her plans ever again. However, his devotion to Chainsaw Man immediately lead to him turning back on this vow and he decides to venture further into danger just for the chance of meeting him.

Himeno was a very tall and voluptuous young woman with smooth and slightly unkempt neck-length black hair, turquoise-colored eyes where she wore a black eyepatch over her right eye.

She was usually seen wearing her suit with a black tie.

In the past when Himeno and Aki Hayakawa were assigned as partners through Kishibe, she used to have longer and straight hair that touched her shoulders, bandages over her right eye as well as a sling on her right arm (which she removed right after they began working together, but she still kept her hair to shoulder-length) and she was slightly skinnier back then.

Himeno was shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with upbeat body language and was capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations, such as the initial phase of her group's battle against the Eternity Devil. Himeno motivated Denji by offering him a french kiss, implying that she's at least somewhat perceptive of the people around her and was willing to take unorthodox approaches in order to ensure the best possible results from him.

entities.name: Hirofumi Yoshida
entities.description:
Public Safety Devil Hunter High School Student Denji’s Bodyguard (formerly)

He was a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Tokyo Special Division 7 who worked with Fumiko Mifune. Formerly a Private Devil Hunter, he was considered by Makima as a high-class bodyguard specialist along with Kusakabe and Tamaoki. After joining Public Safety, he had kept tabs on Denji by attending Fourth East High School and has intervened on multiple occasions to prevent Denji from revealing his identity as Chainsaw Man.

Yoshida has mid-length smooth black hair that only reaches the top of his neck, dark eyes, and a slim face. There is a beauty mark under his lips. He has eight piercings on his left ear, though usually, only six are visible below his hair. His piercings are likely a reference to his contract with the Octopus Devil. As a Civilian Devil Hunter, Yoshida wears a casual outfit that consists of an unbuttoned light jacket and dark pants.

Yoshida is quite playful and mischievous and loves to have small talk with his opponents during battle. Although Yoshida always has a smile on his face, he is also ruthless. This side of him is demonstrated when he mercilessly kills Joey of the three Immortal Brothers in a back alley after showing up behind the surviving brother. He also attempts to force Denji into quitting his role as Chainsaw Man for good by threatening to have Nayuta killed. From his interactions with Kishibe, he is revealed to be still attending high school. Yoshida enjoys watching people eat, which is further demonstrated with the few times he prefers watching, and not eating himself.

Hirokazu is a young man with short spiky hair, a scar on his left cheek and black round eyes. He is usually seen wearing a black suit.

At the newbie welcome party he wore a casual shirt.

Hirokazu is shown to have high moral standards as he became flustered when Himeno promised a kiss to whoever killed the devil on their mission and he stated a young woman should not be giving herself away before marriage.

He cares a lot for his teammates, trying to support Kobeni when her fear got the better of her and calling out Power for laughing at her. However he is mistrustful of fiends and Denji, and even suggested handing Denji over to a devil in order for the rest of the team to escape.

The is a Devil that embodies the concept of houses. They are the main antagonist of the first chapter of Chainsaw Man: Buddy Stories.

The House Devil is a large inn in the shape of a cross. It can be compared to the body of a human.

Not much is known about the House Devil's personality, other than the fact they are pretty sadistic like most devils and enjoy toying with and confusing humans before digesting them unsuspectingly.

16 Devil Hunters are led into the House Devil's body including Denji, Power, and Kenzo, and over the next couple of nights it slowly digests them as they try to find out what's causing the disappearances. With only Power and Kenzo remaining, Power accidentally strikes at the House Devil's heart while aiming for Kenzo and reveals who the true culprit is. Due to Denji being a Hybrid, he survives being partially digested and kills the House Devil after transforming.

entities.name: Joey
entities.description:
Joey is a tall man of average build, with long disheveled hair, and sinister eyes. He wears a suit similar to the Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform.

Joey is the middle sibling but appears to be the least mature out of his siblings to the point that he is described as a dumbass by his older brother. He is also a womanizer, being after women no matter what country he is in. He enjoys smoking.

Despite his crude personality, he is still very close to his family, he reacted in shock and was angered by his brother dying, and tried to calm himself and Aldo before his death.

In New York, U.S.A. Joey and his brothers eat at their home. The elder brother tells his brothers about a job he received from federal agents, which involves hunting a person. Joey asks if they will be hunting women, saying that Japan is all about women. The elder brother shows them Chainsaw Man on their television and says they will be paid $2 million if they kill the man. The younger brother, Aldo, expresses fear of dying, but his brothers talk him down, reminding him that they survived many things, even the Gun Devil's onslaught. As they prepare to leave for Japan, the elder brother refers to themselves as "immortal."

The の|Seigi no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of justice. The Fire Devil used the Justice Devil's name and acted as the overarching antagonist of the Justice Devil arc, but the actual Justice Devil appeared as the secondary antagonist of the Falling Devil arc.

The Justice Devil appears as a large, caterpillar-like monster with no eyes nor nose and stone-looking pads on its shoulders.

Nothing is known about the Justice Devil's personality. However, they seem to enjoy eating a lot, which is why the Falling Devil cooks them food.

It's unclear when the name of the Justice Devil began to be used to convince people to enter into contracts with the Fire Devil. The class president, later killed by Asa Mitaka when the War Devil took over her body, and then Yuko claimed to have made a contract with what they thought was the "Justice Devil", and that was still at Fourth East High School, possibly having made contracts with other students.

entities.name: Katana Man
entities.description:
Katana Man (real name unknown), known officially as , is a Devil-human Hybrid who merged with the の|Katana no Akuma}}. His grandfather was the Debt Collector killed by Denji and because of that, he teamed up with Akane to get revenge on Denji and steal his heart.

In the Public Safety Saga, he serves as the titular main antagonist of the Katana Man arc and a minor antagonist in the Control Devil arc.

Katana Man later returns in the Academy Saga as a supporting character, having temporarily joined Public Safety as a member of Tokyo Special Division 7 with the personal agenda of reviving his grandfather's Yakuza syndicate and killing his arch-nemesis Denji.

Katana Man is a very tall and muscular young man with short black hair, eyes and notable sideburns. In his debut arc, Katana Man dresses in a large leather trench coat layered over a buttoned dark military-styled uniform. Around his waist is a dark utility belt with visible pouches and a scabbard holding one of his swords. His pants and footware also matches the dark tones of his outfit. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, Katana Man wore the Public Safety Devil Hunter suit and tie.

entities.name: Kato
entities.description:
Kato is an average man who normally dresses in the standard Public Safety uniform. He appears to be a bit older and missing an eye.

Kato is a devil hunter, but he didn't hesitate to use his abilities on Reze despite her appearing like an ordinary human girl, readily obeying his superior's orders.

Kato is first seen at the Anti-Devil 2nd Division's Training Facility, while Reze is attacking the facility. Kato along with Tanabe are the first ones to try and stop her. Using their devil contract they grow mold inside her heart and intestines, causing internal bleeding. Reze however blows her own head off and throws it into the facility, where she regenerates. Her original headless body runs at the pair and causes an explosion, killing him.

entities.description:
Prime Minister Ishita is an ageing elderly figure with short, dark hair. He has two moles near his left eyebrow and noticeable wrinkles.

Despite being the leader of Japan's government, Ishita is a rather meek individual. He seems to react with fear or bewilderment upon hearing Public Safety's plan on erasing the Aging Devil, and he has no qualms in letting Tadashi Hasegawa - someone who theoretically should have no power over him - take initiative in agreeing to the plan.

At some point in time, Kentaro Ishita became the Prime Minister of Japan.

Kentaro Ishita is one of the Japanese Government Officials who had a meeting in order to discuss the potential of erasing the Aging Devil from existence and its affects on the people of Japan.

entities.name: Kobeni's car
entities.description:
Kobeni's car is small, with a roundish roof, small wheels, a boxy front, a rectangular window shield, two doors and an older fashioned steering wheel. Kobeni's car is seen painted a bright yellow, leaning more towards pastel than vibrant.

Kobeni bought this car with her own money to chauffeur her family.

Power notices Kobeni's car and demands her for a ride before claiming that it is her own car that Kobeni stole. She then gets inside the driver's seat and threatens Kobeni into allowing her to drive, while reassuring her she has a driver's license, which she doesn't. Kobeni gets inside as well to try and stop Power but is unsuccessful, as the fiend rams the car straight into Denji and Kurose, killing the latter. Power immediately shifts the blame to Kobeni for the incident and unrepentantly calls Kobeni a murderer since the car belongs to her. However, Kurose's face then changed into another person's that does not look like Kurose at all. It is then revealed that Kurose's persona was taken by the elder brother of Joey and Aldo, who was planning to assassinate Denji. Power, after discovering that the one she crashed into and killed was an enemy, pridefully declares that she was the only one who saw through the assassin's disguise. Later, Kobeni kneels down by her car to inspect the damage and anxiously worries about how much will it cost to fix the dent.

Later on, inside the department store, Kobeni observes in horror as both Kishibe and Aldo land on top of her car, crushing the roof in and leaving her in shock.

entities.name: Kusakabe
entities.description:
Kusakabe has dirty blonde or light brown hair which extends to his upper neck. He wears black glasses, has either hazel or yellow eyes with a slightly muted hue, and a black suit like most of the Public Safety Devil Hunters.

Kusakabe is cautious and rigorous. He is the one who become furious when Denji tried to eat his food even after it fell to ground, as well as exhorting Power to eat her vegetables. According to Makima, he is one of the best bodyguards. He cares about his mission and prepared.

When Makima finds out that Denji's existence is revealed in the media, and that assassins from other countries will come to kill him, Makima orders her subordinates to get several Public Safety Devil Hunters, which includes Kusakabe. Tamaoki states he is Kusakabe's buddy. Kusakabe insists that Denji speak to him politely and follow his meticulous instructions on patrol routes.

They begin walking inside the department store when they realize that Santa Claus’ dolls are pursuing them. Kusakabe uses his contract with the Stone Devil to incapacitate the dolls. They race further inside up the escalator when suddenly Quanxi arrives, decapitating the dolls pursuing them, and attack their group. Kusakabe and Tamaoki begin to fight but are swiftly taken down by the Chinese Devil Hunter.

entities.description:
The |Hiru no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of leeches. She is the secondary antagonist of the Bat Devil arc.

The Leech Devil has a large wrinkled body with four legs and two tentacle-like arms. Her limbs are tipped with circular orifices like a leech and her face consists entirely of a single large mouth with blocky teeth. In the colored manga she is yellowish but in the anime she has more realistic dark leech colors. She has long black hair, and three pairs of udder-like glands.

The Leech Devil, like most devils, has a great hatred for humans. She cared deeply for the Bat Devil, referring to him affectionately and trying to avenge him after his death. She and the Bat Devil shared a dream of devouring all humans together. Despite her relationship with him however, she seemed willing to spare Denji purely because he has a cute face.

At some point the Leech Devil became the girlfriend of the Bat Devil.

entities.name: Lion Devil
entities.description:
The |Raion no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of lions.

The Lion Devil appears as a grotesque, distorted leonine creature. Its head resembles that of a lion, but with exaggerated and unsettling features, including bulging eyes, an uneven muzzle, human ears, and jagged, irregular teeth. Its fur is coarse and patchy, clinging unevenly to its skull and neck, giving it a feral and diseased appearance rather than a majestic one.

The Devil's facial structure is asymmetrical and warped, emphasizing its unnatural origin. Rather than evoking nobility, its design conveys madness, hunger, and raw predatory instinct. The Lion Devil's design emphasizes distortion and madness rather than realism, highlighting fear over admiration.

The Lion Devil's personality is largely unknown. As a non-humanoid devil, it is presumed to be driven primarily by instinct rather than rational thought and carries hatred for humans like most Devils, and sustained by the fear that gives it power. It also shows respect to Yoru and refers to her as "Lady Yoru".

entities.name: Locust Devil
entities.description:
The |Batta no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of locusts and large-scale infestation. It serves as a minor antagonist in the War Devil arc.

The Locust Devil appears as a tall, broad-shouldered humanoid with a heavily segmented, insect-like body. Its head is small relative to its torso and lacks distinct human features, instead resembling an insectoid mask, and a pair of long, thin antennae extend from its head, further emphasizing its insectoid nature. Its physique is bulky and asymmetrical, covered in uneven, chitinous plating that gives it a crude, swarm-formed obsolete appearance.

It has four thick arms ending in large, blunt hands with short, claw-like fingers, and unevenly proportioned legs. Four large, rigid wings resembling those of a locust extend from its back. These elongated, overlapping wings dominate its silhouette when viewed from behind, emphasizing its association with swarms rather than flight. Its overall posture is rigid and imposing, evoking both predatory stillness and the threat of sudden movement.

Little is known about the Locust Devil’s personality. As a non-humanoid devil, it is presumed to harbour instinctive hostility toward humans. Its behavior appears driven by consumption and spread rather than communication, reflecting the indiscriminate devastation caused by locust swarms.

entities.name: Long
entities.description:
Long possesses a corpse with shaggy, dark purple-red hair that is around shoulder length. She also has a pair of red horns. Her eyes have red irises and yellow pupils. Her sweater is white with red shorts. She has muted red sneakers as well as cuffs on her hands.

She is shown to be battle hungry and only caring about the smell and taste of blood. She seems to be submissive and is usually seen with her wrists chained.

Long is shown assisting Quanxi and her fellow fiends finish off the remaining dolls outside the mall, before getting apprehended by Kishibe. She is later brought over to the mall and she is held at knifepoint by Denji. During Aldo's attempt to intervene, Denji releases Long, after which she subdues him in a chokehold. Aldo fires at Long, but she blocks the gunshots with her arm and breathes fire at him. Aldo evades the blow and fires at her again, which Long blocks in a similar manner from before. After Quanxi deals with Aldo, Long is told by Power to stay back, or she'll kill Pingtsi and to release Denji as well. She is then attacked by Beam, who hurls Long away from Denji, allowing him to escape from her.

Long is sent to Hell with the other Devil Hunters at the mall, while freaking out with the rest of the fiends. She is killed by the Darkness Devil but returns as one of Santa Claus' dolls later in order to intimidate Quanxi.

The |Manekin no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of mannequins. They are the main antagonist of the second chapter of Chainsaw Man: Buddy Stories.

The Mannequin Devil's true form is described as a tiny, battered doll binded together with black feathers. When using its powers, it can mimic the likeness of anyone that touches one of its blank mannequin host bodies.

Although not much is known about the Mannequin Devil's personality, it is shown to be sadistic and deceiving when attacking Kishibe, Quanxi, and Minami using their likeness for its mannequin hosts. It harbors a strong desire to copy the appearances of those who come into physical contact with them.

The Mannequin Devil resided inside an abandoned factory, where a couple of children reported that they heard its inhumane voice within the darkness of the area. On Minami's first Devil hunting mission with Kishibe and Quanxi, the three were sent to hunt it down. When entering the factory, the Devil Hunters discovered multiple abandoned mannequins lying around the area. One of the mannequins attempts to attack Minami but is swiftly knocked down by Quanxi despite having changed its likeness to that of Minami's.

Power eventually becomes attached to Meowy and they were together for a long time until Meowy was captured by the Bat Devil, who promised that if a human were brought to him he would return Meowy.

When Power returned with Denji, Meowy was eaten by the Bat Devil as punishment for bringing him blood that tasted disgusting. Meowy was freed along with Power after the defeat of the Bat Devil.

It seemed that Meowy frequently slept with Denji rather than Power which slightly annoyed her.

She tends to wear the standard Public Safety Devil Hunter uniform, and has a horizontal scar across her face, a feature she shared with Yutaro Kurose.

Like Yutaro, Michiko is nervous around Makima and insists that she doesn't want to join the special division. Michiko appears to have some sensitivity as she suggested stepping out to give Aki some space when she and Yutaro found him crying.

Michiko's life was ruined by the Gun Devil which was her motivation for joining Public Safety though she never tried to kill it herself, believing it to be impossible.

entities.name: Miri Sugo
entities.description:
Miri later returns in the Academy Saga as a supporting character, working under the orders of Barem and the Chainsaw Man Church alongside his other fellow Weapon Humans.

Miri is a young man of average height with unkempt black hair that goes down to the middle of his neck and visible dark circles under his blue eyes. He wears a drawstring hoodie underneath his Fourth East High School uniform with dark pants and white sneakers. During his time as one of Makima's brainwashed servants, he wore the Public Safety Devil Hunter suit over his hoodie. His human appearance is noted as looking halfway between Denji and Haruka by his fellow classmates.

Initially, Miri's real personality was unknown due to being brainwashed and mind-controlled by Makima, although it seemed like he enjoyed attention and wanted to impress Makima. His character biography for the Second Popularity Poll refers to him as a young man with a light impression on things.

Post-mind control, Miri does seem to be fairly regretful for his actions during the fight, as he was able to seek out Denji to talk to him in private and empathize with his current situation. His regret stems from how he allowed himself to be manipulated by Makima, similar to Denji. As such, not only does Miri highly value his newfound free will, but he also wants to befriend Denji out of gratitude for killing Makima and freeing him from her control. entities.description:
The Mysterious Man is an adult man with a notable blond mohawk and a large vertical scar that covers most of his face. He usually is shown with a deranged expression and wears a brown trench coat, a pair of jeans, and brown boots.

The Mysterious Man is a deranged lunatic who revels in slaughtering innocent lives for his own personal gain, especially when targeting his targets' loved ones to break them emotionally. He also has an interest in mutilating his targets by cutting and slicing them apart.

At an undisclosed bathroom, the Mysterious Man makes his plans of targeting Reze to lure Denji out for his heart. The man wishes to know why the devils are so interested in getting the Chainsaw's heart. Instead of answering his question the Typhoon Devil tells him to be wary of the human with Chainsaw's heart as he has already killed many devils. The man refutes this as the result of the devil's stupidity and tells a story to the Typhoon Devil of how he killed a feared devil hunter in China by taking his wife and daughter hostage and torturing them.

Later on, upon locating both Denji and Reze at a school, the Typhoon Devil creates a storm to trap them inside the building. Once Denji agrees to meet up again at a festival on the next day, Reze heads to the restrooms in good spirits. The serial killer then emerges from the shadows and chases her onto the school's balcony. Before the deranged figure can kill her, Reze swiftly disarms him and slowly strangles him to death. Getting back up, the unfettered Reze coldly tells the Typhoon Devil to dispose of the serial killer's corpse before heading back to check on Denji.

They make their debut in the Chainsaw Man Church arc, and reappear as a supporting character in the Aging Devil arc.

The Nail Fiend is dressed in the typical office worker and jacket attire of other Public Safety members. Their most notable feature is their face, which is completely split in half. The right half of their face is mostly cracked open and showing only nail-riddled brain matter even though other organs should be present.

In particular, there is a prominent crack on their right cheek, possibly as a result of the injury that caused their initial death, or one they sustained prior to it. The left half of their face is covered by a long fringe that reaches down to their nose. The hair on the back of their head is medium-length and flares outward.
